verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official Drata MCP server that lets external AI agents interact with Drata. That is the server role. Nothing shows Drata acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools. Because a compliance SaaS with AI features could plausibly offer such a client capability, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
